exposure: fetal weight by last ultrasound before labor
cohort: The study included 3,025 singleton pregnancies of women willing to undergo vaginal delivery at admission at a single hospital in China between August 2021 and March 2022.
finding: The developed nomogram model, utilizing nine admission indicators, demonstrated good predictive performance for the risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The model, using admission indicators, performed well in predicting the risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery.
